title: gitlab fetch_config
description: Merge and review settings. One ACCOUNT record for the group (metadata scope ACCOUNT) and one REPO record per discovered project (metadata scope REPO). The connector builds the outer object; the GitLab REST bodies inside it are passed through unchanged.

group_settings.description: The GitLab REST group object (GET /groups/:id), unchanged.

merge_method.description: merge, rebase_merge or ff; empty when GitLab sent none.

squash_option.description: never, always, default_on or default_off; empty when GitLab sent none.

approvals.description: The GitLab REST project approvals body (GET /projects/:id/approvals), unchanged. Omitted when the call failed.

protected_branches.description: The GitLab REST protected branch objects, unchanged. Omitted when the call failed or returned none.
